name: L11_wallResolved_WT
note: The prism-layer recipe adopted 2026-08-24 (results/layer_recipe_verdict.json): 11 layers at expansionRatio 1.45 on a surface-level-11 skin, wall-resolved, Condition WT (M 0.12, |U| 40.800000 m/s, Re_cref 0.95e6), which is what the L11 pair and the whole phaseA campaign actually ran. Assembled from the UNSUFFIXED dicts of layers/L11_base and layers/L11_morph, which are the files snappyHexMeshDict actually #includes. The pair's layerSettings are byte-identical (sha e63fcb21...), which is what makes either an acceptable source for it. fvSchemes was damaged in BOTH L11 cases and came from phaseA/A1_er133; that variant is carried by 22 of the ~30 cases on scratch and is confirmed present on the production cases CTE_a1p40 and MR_mcv2, so it is the campaign standard rather than a settings-rig one-off. THIS SUBSTITUTION IS THE ONE FILE IN THIS FOLDER THAT DID NOT COME FROM AN L11 CASE.

edits_after_capture.why: 300 is what the L11 layer study ran, not what v5 needs. THE RECIPE FOLDER IS THE v5 TEMPLATE, NOT AN ARCHAEOLOGICAL CAPTURE: a stored recipe that says 300 while the campaign wants 4500 invites exactly the confusion this folder exists to prevent. 4500 is the pinned v5 value in hpc/v5_recipe.json, derived from CRB_a1p75's drift trend.

AT 1e-6/1e-7 SIMPLE CAN STOP EARLY ON RESIDUALS, PRE-EMPTING THE FORCE GATE. The standing convergence basis in this project is force-history stationarity, not residualControl, and the run-card schema says so outright: no case here meets the residual targets. Worse, an early residual stop breaks solve_v5.slurm's loop specifically: the run exits normally with latestTime < endTime, the loop reads that as a walltime kill and requeues, the restart satisfies residualControl again within a few iterations, and it burns all four legs before stopping. The CR production cases already carry 1e-9/1e-10, which is effectively unreachable and lets the run go to endTime so the force gate decides. Both recipes now match them.

condition_correction: Folder renamed from L11_wallResolved_CR to _WT. The dicts are Condition WT: 0.orig/U has |Uinf| = 40.800000 m/s (M 0.12) and forceCoeffs1 magUInf 40.8 agrees with it. The original _CR name was asserted from the 'CR' prefix on phaseA case names without reading the freestream, and it was wrong. The dicts were never wrong.
